directories.name: 211 Ontario
directories.notes: Public, no login/CAPTCHA. A real Chromium session with a desktop UA hit NO bot-check (the prior HTTP-only pass had stalled at 15 records). The location field requires a geocoded lat/long (autocomplete-driven); once supplied, a keyword search for 'basketball' with a large radius (sd=2500km, anchored at Toronto) returns a stable 171-record result set across 7 pages. Verified this is the FULL provincial result set: re-running the identical search anchored at Thunder Bay (sd=2500) returned the exact same 171 record IDs, and increasing sd further (5000, 100000) only added ~1 more record — so one province-wide sweep is sufficient, no need to re-run per-region. Of the 171 keyword matches (most are generic community/rec centres, YMCAs, Special Olympics chapters, First Nations recreation depts that only mention 'basketball' as one of many activities), 19 are basketball-specific clubs/leagues/officiating bodies with their own contact record; all 19 yielded a real email address on the detail page (obfuscated only via 211's own mailto footer, easily distinguished from the org's own mailto links).

directories.name: CIOC Peel (InfoPeel Services Directory)
directories.notes: Public, works via plain GET (no JS needed): search form action is bresults.asp?STerms=<query>, not the '?Ss=' pattern suggested in the brief. 18 keyword matches for 'basketball'; 3 are basketball-specific clubs not present in the 211ontario.ca provincial sweep (Brampton, Caledon, Peel-region D3P) -- i.e. this regional CIOC instance carries listings 211ontario.ca does not have synced. Detail pages (/record/<ID>) expose Office Phone / E-Mail / Website / Address in a plain label/value table; emails are numeric-HTML-entity obfuscated (e.g. da...) but trivially decoded.

directories.name: CIOC Halton (InfoHalton)

No net-new organizations, but cross-confirms the contact details already collected.

directories.name: Community Connection (successor to Central East Ontario / InfoBarrie / Simcoe County / Orillia CIOC instances)

Same 211-platform template as 211ontario.ca. Coverage is tag-based ('Serving <region>') rather than pure-radius, so a single anchor point does not surface everything -- swept from 7 regional anchors (Barrie, Peterborough, Owen Sound, Collingwood, Cobourg, Huntsville, Parry Sound) at max radius and merged by record ID: 46 unique keyword matches for 'basketball'. 3 basketball-specific orgs not present anywhere else (Barrie Royals Basketball Club, Barrie and District Association of Basketball Officials, Next Level Basketball); 2 more (Shak's World Community Centre programs) duplicate records already captured from 211ontario.ca.

summary: Harvested 25 basketball organizations with real contact details (24 of 25 have an email; 12 also have a working phone number; a few adult/wheelchair/officials orgs explicitly show 'no public telephone number' on the source record) from Ontario community-services directories, via a real Chromium session (no bot-check ever triggered once a proper desktop UA + Accept-Language header was set -- contrary to the earlier HTTP-only pass that stalled at 15 records on 211ontario.ca). Key finding: 211ontario.ca, halton.cioc.ca and info-bhn.cioc.ca all draw from the same underlying data pool -- a single province-wide 211ontario.ca sweep (171 'basketball' keyword matches, confirmed identical regardless of anchor city) already contains everything those regional CIOC mirrors would add. Net-new sources were: (1) peel.cioc.ca, which is NOT synced to 211ontario.ca and added 3 orgs (Brampton Minor Basketball Association, Caledon Cougars Basketball Association, D3P Sports); and (2) cc.search211.ca ('Community Connection'), the live successor to the now-dead Central East Ontario / InfoBarrie / Simcoe County / Orillia CIOC instances, which added 3 more (Barrie Royals Basketball Club, Barrie and District Association of Basketball Officials, Next Level Basketball). Three of the nine originally-listed CIOC targets (niagara, centraleastontario-family, and by extension infobarrie/simcoecounty/orillia) have migrated to new 211-platform-family domains, which were located and searched directly. regionofwaterloo.cioc.ca is dead with no working searchable successor found -- Waterloo Region basketball clubs remain a gap in this data source. Included several adult-league, wheelchair-basketball and officials/referee associations alongside youth clubs since they carry real contact info and downstream deduplication can triage; each entry's notes flag what kind of organization it is.
